decisions.reason: As the current analytics standard for online shops, GA4 fits the firm's core service bundle and in a growing e-commerce market would likely meet aspirations well enough to retain.

Because Universal Analytics was being phased out and offers little future customer value in 2024, its expected performance is likely far below aspiration and management would reallocate resources elsewhere.

A retail system interface plugin matches the firm's technical integration capabilities and should be worth keeping unless uptake clearly disappoints, especially with some room to carry promising complements to the core business.

A shop relaunch SEO support service is tightly aligned with the firm's established project, marketing, and conversion expertise and was prominent enough on the website to suggest satisfactory early prospects.
